reason: Build-time lint; no endpoint, schema, status code or message added or changed (story file v1 §10, TC-TE-011-11). API Specification v4 is read as an input file only.

buildToolContract.trigger: Every pipeline that .gitlab-ci.yml creates. The file has no workflow: block, so GitLab creates branch pipelines only, on every branch including main and develop-recovery; locally, scripts/dev.ps1 test before the orchestrator's merge (story file v1 §12; SPEC-TE011-013)
inputs: Dictionary as seeded and changed by migrations: sys_fields.is_personal from the baseline infra/postgres/schema/03-recovery-physical-schema-v6.sql, then backend/src/main/resources/db/modulemigration/recovery/*.sql in Flyway order (a migration row replaces a baseline row), then any configured dictionary file. Recognised forms: INSERT ... VALUES single-row or multi-row; UPDATE ... SET is_personal WHERE field_id = / IN (literal ids). Any other statement writing sys_fields fails closed (SPEC-TE011-001). Marks made by a D-RCV-29 dictionary load are not read: the lint covers committed SQL, fixtures and logs only (seam owned by RWB-E1-064, decision in RWB-E1-043 open item R4 owned by RW-COMPLY; SPEC-TE011-017)

The recovery migration folder is read from rwb.flyway.location in backend/src/main/resources/application.yaml (classpath: mapped to backend/src/main/resources/). Scan roots must cover, and exclusions and lint-fixture roots must not match, any file or probe path in that folder; a mismatch with dictionary.migrationFolder or a missing or non-classpath property gives exit 2 (SPEC-TE011-003)

Lint fixtures: lintFixtureRoots, default backend/src/test/resources/migration-lint/** (RWB-E1-044 lint fixtures); FIXTURE-ID only on the raw text, never parsed, never exit 2 from content. Every root must lie under the test roots, otherwise exit 2 (SPEC-TE011-003)

Changed-file list: --changed-files-from-git <target> builds it from git merge-base <target> HEAD and git diff --name-only --diff-filter=AMR <merge-base>..HEAD. GitLab branch pipeline (GIT_DEPTH 0): origin/<changedFiles.targetBranch> on any other branch; none on the target branch itself. GitLab merge request pipeline, if added: origin/$CI_MERGE_REQUEST_TARGET_BRANCH_NAME. Local merge: scripts/dev.ps1 test with develop-recovery. Target not found or no merge base: exit 2. No option: empty list (SPEC-TE011-013, -018)
buildToolContract.generated: pdpa-rules.yaml in build output, CI artifact, not committed (SPEC-TE011-002)
buildToolContract.outputLine: {rule}: {file}:{line} uses personal field {field}. Remove it or use the masking helper.

exitCodes.2: configuration or input error, including an unsupported sys_fields statement in a file the reader reads, a duplicate seed row across migrations, an UPDATE of an unknown field_id, an allow entry whose path matches a migration, a scan configuration that excludes or omits the migration folder or lets a lint-fixture root cover it, a lint-fixture root outside the test roots, a migration folder that does not match rwb.flyway.location, a corrective migration in the migration folder that names an unknown file, or a changed-file target branch that cannot be resolved or has no merge base with HEAD. A lint-fixture file never gives exit 2 from its content

buildToolContract.neverPrinted: Any value found, any source line or SQL statement text, any fixture value (BR7)
buildToolContract.state: None; rerun to restart; same commit and dictionary give the same output
buildToolContract.fixtureMatching: FIXTURE-FIELD matches by (object, field) keys: object_name.field_name, source_field table.column, API schema.property. A position is resolved only when the dictionary describes that field on that object; otherwise (no object, an object outside the dictionary, or an undescribed field) an unambiguous name is a finding, an API personal name in an API-typed position is a finding, and an ambiguous name gives a notice. Scanned SQL with no named column (column-less INSERT with a literal, COPY ... FROM, \copy ... from) is a finding with field (columns not named) (SPEC-TE011-008). Every scanned SQL statement is classified: position forms (named-column INSERT with ON CONFLICT, RETURNING, WHERE or a read-only WITH; UPDATE ... SET), non-position forms (DDL, COMMENT ON, grants, settings, transaction control, reads, DELETE, TRUNCATE, maintenance), procedural bodies, and anything else. Anything else is a finding with field (statement not recognised); DML in a DO block is a finding with field (DML in procedural body) (SPEC-TE011-008). A non-NULL DEFAULT literal on a resolved personal pair is a position. In a DO body, reads, control flow, direct class-2 statements (DDL, COMMENT ON, GRANT, REVOKE, SET, RESET, DELETE, TRUNCATE) and EXECUTE of a string literal or format(<literal>, ...) whose text is class 2 when classed as a top-level statement raise nothing; every other statement (INSERT, UPDATE, MERGE, COPY, CALL, any other EXECUTE, a class-4 statement such as CREATE TABLE ... AS or ALTER ROLE, an unknown keyword) gives (DML in procedural body) by a catch-all. Function and procedure bodies follow the same rules, except that a named-column INSERT or UPDATE is checked as a position form. ALTER and DROP FUNCTION or PROCEDURE are non-position forms; CREATE TABLE ... AS is not recognised
noticeLines: PDPA-NOTICE: {file}:{line} object not resolved for {field}; add a fixtureObjects entry or a typed receiver
PDPA-NOTICE: {file}:{line} seeds {field}, marked personal by a later migration
buildToolContract.correctiveMigration: Applies only to files in the recovery migration folder. A finding in a merged migration O is accepted only when a later migration C (Flyway order) has O's line-1 story key, a line 2 starting '-- Fix:' with a non-empty reason that names O (token V\d{4}__[A-Za-z0-9_]+\.sql), and O is not on the changed-file list; the changed-file condition applies to every finding. For a finding with a target table, C also holds an UPDATE, DELETE or TRUNCATE on that table; for a finding in a DEFAULT (FIXTURE-FIELD or FIXTURE-ID), C also holds ALTER COLUMN ... DROP or SET DEFAULT. Target tables: a position's table; the table of a column-less INSERT or COPY; the table a statement writes when readable (MERGE INTO, SELECT ... INTO, CREATE TABLE ... AS, COPY data block), for FIXTURE-FIELD and FIXTURE-ID alike; the table of a DEFAULT. A finding with no target table (FIXTURE-ID in a comment, COMMENT ON text, other DDL, a procedural body, CALL or SET; DML in procedural body) needs no table write, but every other condition applies (SPEC-TE011-018)
